title: Trump Awards Medal of Freedom to Welles Crowther, the ‘Man in the Red Bandanna’
summary: Welles Remy Crowther, an equity trader and volunteer firefighter, is credited with saving 18 people at the World Trade Center on Sept. 11 before being killed.
body_markdown: Welles Remy Crowther, an equity trader and volunteer firefighter, is credited with saving 18 people at the World Trade Center on Sept. 11 before being killed.
